title: 006. Product of Array Except Self
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is equal to the product of all the elements of `nums` except `nums[i]`. You must write an algorithm that runs in `O(N)` time and without using the division operation.

hints.title: Mental Model & Intuition
hints.content: Every index `i` needs the product of everything to its left multiplied by the product of everything to its right.

hints.title: Pattern Identification
hints.content: Two-pass Prefix & Suffix running products stored directly inside the output array `res` for `O(1)` extra space.

hints.title: Algorithmic Invariant
hints.content: Pass 1 (Left → Right): store running `prefix` in `res[i]`, then `prefix *= nums[i]`. Pass 2 (Right → Left): multiply `res[i] *= suffix`, then `suffix *= nums[i]`.

hints.title: Edge Cases & Scaffolding
hints.content: Test arrays containing a single `0` (only the zero's position is non-zero) and arrays with two `0`s (all outputs become `0`).
